require 'ffi'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'

module NativeImageLib
  extend FFI::Library
  ffi_lib './libimgproc.so'

  attach_function :img_resize, [:pointer, :int, :int, :int, :pointer], :int
  attach_function :img_rotate, [:pointer, :int, :float, :pointer], :int
  attach_function :img_filter, [:pointer, :int, :string, :pointer], :int
  attach_function :alloc_buffer, [:int], :pointer
  attach_function :free_buffer, [:pointer], :void
end

module AccessControl
  ROLES = {
    'admin' => { max_dimension: 8192, filters: :all, batch_limit: 100 },
    'editor' => { max_dimension: 4096, filters: [:blur, :sharpen, :grayscale], batch_limit: 20 },
    'viewer' => { max_dimension: 1024, filters: [:grayscale], batch_limit: 5 }
  }.freeze

  def self.check_permission(user_role, operation, params)
    role_config = ROLES[user_role]
    return false unless role_config

    case operation
    when :resize
      params[:width] <= role_config[:max_dimension] &&
        params[:height] <= role_config[:max_dimension]
    when :filter
      role_config[:filters] == :all || role_config[:filters].include?(params[:filter_name].to_sym)
    when :batch
      params[:count] <= role_config[:batch_limit]
    else
      false
    end
  end
end

class ImagePipeline
  HEADER_SIZE = 16
  MAX_PIXEL_BYTES = 4

  def initialize(user_role)
    @user_role = user_role
    @operations = []
    @session_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
  end

  def add_resize(width, height)
    unless AccessControl.check_permission(@user_role, :resize, { width: width, height: height })
      raise SecurityError, "Insufficient permissions for resize #{width}x#{height}"
    end
    @operations << { type: :resize, width: width.to_i, height: height.to_i }
    self
  end

  def add_filter(filter_name)
    unless AccessControl.check_permission(@user_role, :filter, { filter_name: filter_name })
      raise SecurityError, "Insufficient permissions for filter: #{filter_name}"
    end
    @operations << { type: :filter, name: filter_name.to_s }
    self
  end

  def execute(image_data)
    validate_image_header!(image_data)
    current_buffer = load_to_native(image_data)
    current_size = image_data.bytesize

    @operations.each do |op|
      case op[:type]
      when :resize
        current_buffer, current_size = perform_resize(current_buffer, current_size, op)
      when :filter
        current_buffer, current_size = perform_filter(current_buffer, current_size, op)
      end
    end

    result = current_buffer.read_bytes(current_size)
    NativeImageLib.free_buffer(current_buffer)
    result
  end

  private

  def validate_image_header!(data)
    raise ArgumentError, "Image data too small" if data.bytesize < HEADER_SIZE
    magic = data[0..3]
    raise ArgumentError, "Invalid image format" unless ['\x89PNG', 'RIFF', '\xFF\xD8\xFF\xE0'].include?(magic)
  end

  def load_to_native(image_data)
    buf = NativeImageLib.alloc_buffer(image_data.bytesize)
    buf.write_bytes(image_data)
    buf
  end

  def compute_output_size(current_size, op)
    width = op[:width]
    height = op[:height]
    pixel_count = width * height
    output_size = HEADER_SIZE + (pixel_count * MAX_PIXEL_BYTES)
    output_size
  end

  def perform_resize(input_buffer, input_size, op)
    output_size = compute_output_size(input_size, op)
    output_buffer = NativeImageLib.alloc_buffer(output_size)

    result = NativeImageLib.img_resize(
      input_buffer, input_size,
      op[:width], op[:height],
      output_buffer
    )

    NativeImageLib.free_buffer(input_buffer)
    raise RuntimeError, "Resize failed with code #{result}" unless result == 0
    [output_buffer, output_size]
  end

  def perform_filter(input_buffer, input_size, op)
    output_buffer = NativeImageLib.alloc_buffer(input_size)

    result = NativeImageLib.img_filter(
      input_buffer, input_size,
      op[:name],
      output_buffer
    )

    NativeImageLib.free_buffer(input_buffer)
    raise RuntimeError, "Filter failed with code #{result}" unless result == 0
    [output_buffer, input_size]
  end
end

class BatchProcessor
  def initialize(user_role)
    @user_role = user_role
  end

  def process_batch(requests)
    unless AccessControl.check_permission(@user_role, :batch, { count: requests.length })
      raise SecurityError, "Batch size #{requests.length} exceeds role limit"
    end

    requests.map do |req|
      pipeline = ImagePipeline.new(@user_role)
      req['operations'].each do |op|
        case op['type']
        when 'resize'
          pipeline.add_resize(op['width'], op['height'])
        when 'filter'
          pipeline.add_filter(op['filter'])
        end
      end
      { id: req['id'], result: pipeline.execute(req['data']) }
    end
  end
end
